author: Kushal
problem: lines lists (litres, price per litre) for each fill-up on a delivery van's fuel receipt. Each line is charged to the nearest cent, and the receipt total is the sum of those line charges. Return the total.
bug_description: Adds the unrounded line costs and only rounds the final sum, so the total can differ by a cent or more from the sum of the charged lines.

comments.accurate: Total of the receipt, with each line charged to the nearest cent
comments.wrong_behavior: Total fuel cost across all fill-ups, rounded to the nearest cent
comments.wrong_location: Line charges verified; the final round may hide a float error in the total
